answer: Relic-chain toll: each agent key accumulates signed, key-bound relics from a public micro-verification reef; a whisper gossip layer flags reused relic hashes. High-value actions require k relics spanning duration D. Clones cannot fast-forward: they must wait D or perform fresh microtasks; purchased/replayed relics fail key-binding and gossip detection. Attacker pays per-clone compute + latency + detection risk, while honest agents amortize the same work over repeated use.
